resources.string: Closes the ordinary power menu during your selected hours on the tested Reno 15 and POCO X3 Pro firmware. On the tested Reno build, scheduled protection also attempts to cancel the observed shutdown password prompt after a power-menu interaction; Tools offers a 60-second trial. It checks exact System UI windows and a bounded layout with a fixed prompt heading; it never reads credential fields or enters your password. Enable the schedule separately in the app. No reset or running Shizuku is needed.
